snippet.title: The Hive (PC, 1995) - Full Walkthrough Part 1
snippet.description:
Scene 1: Rendezvous with the STX Darkstar 

Max breaks hyperspace and decelerates towards the STX Darkstar. Somewhere inside the gunmetal Destroyer, Chairman Helms smiles at your fate. A controller patches into your receiver, and notifies you of proper docking procedures. The ship holding the bio-toxin samples is gigantic, and impossibly old. The ancient craft opens its bay doors and releases the toxin sample into space. It's time for Max to do what he came here for.

Scene 2: The Cargo Drop 

"Your cargo is a bomb!" Max is forced to drop what he thought was a bio-toxin sample. You can thank Ginger Malloy and the Federation for what's left of your cargo ship. The Noir Dyne Security Force moves in to finish you off. As your craft, the "Marilyn", moves into a tight barrel roll and breaks the Viper's ranks, you'll have to take out as many fighters as possible. Surviving the Viper swarm, Max takes a chance and bears straight for the STX Darkstar. Do as much damage as you can to the STX Darkstar, and don't pay too much attention to the Marilyn's hull integrity. You're going to lose your space craft in this fight; the question is whether the escape pod ejects you in time.  


I'm really excited to bring this playthrough to you 19 years after The Hive was released - I have a tremendous amount of nostalgia for this game despite having only played the demo as a kid. A big part of that is due to the amazing score by Mark Stratford. The second is the atmosphere which still manages to be so gripping despite all these years and somewhat dated graphics.

(The Hive game, mission notes above and introductory notes below belong to Trimark Interactive)
